section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Satisfaction With Life Scale (SWLS), a 5-item instrument used to measure global life satisfaction on a 7-point scale. The section notes that the Romanian version of the scale has demonstrated one-dimensional factor structure and convergent validity, and reports Cronbach's alpha values of .85 for women and .86 for men in the present study. This is an instrument description subsection and does not contain study-level demographic or statistical data.
